styles.name: growing-vine
styles.description: A vine climbs left-to-right; leaf crosses sprout at every 10% milestone

styles.name: grass-blades
styles.description: Individual grass blades grow taller with progress and sway in the wind

styles.name: sunrise
styles.description: A rayed sun climbs out of the sea, red at dawn turning gold, its glitter shimmering on the water

styles.name: rain-gauge
styles.description: Raindrops fall from a cloud; the water level rises with progress

styles.name: tree-rings
styles.description: A sawn log grows longer with progress; its cut end shows growth rings that add up year by year as sawdust falls

styles.name: mountain-snow
styles.description: A jagged grey mountain range under falling snowflakes; white snowcaps creep down the slopes with progress

styles.name: four-seasons
styles.description: The year sweeps by in four hatched bands, each revealing its emblem: spring flower, summer sun, autumn leaf, winter snowflake

styles.name: flower-bloom
styles.description: A row of tulips sprouts left to right; each bud swells and opens into a three-petal cup, swaying

styles.name: falling-leaves
styles.description: Red, orange and gold leaves tumble down swaying and pile up into a heap that spreads with progress

styles.name: lightning-bolt
styles.description: A storm cloud rolls in with progress; zigzag lightning bolts strike the ground from its leading edge
